annotations.title: Extract text from a web page or PDF

description: Extract structured text from a public web page or text-based PDF for 0.02 USDC on Base via x402. Limits: one public URL up to 5 MiB; default 30,000 output characters (maxChars 500-100,000); no OCR (scanned PDFs without a text layer) or JavaScript rendering. Failed extractions are not settled. Payment is only made after buyer approval.
name: via_extract_page
